+"""Bounded recovery after a scope exit or an interrupted CLI session."""
+
+import sys
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock

+from fortinet.common.cli_commands import (  # noqa: E402

+    EditBlock, SessionLossAction,

+from fortinet.common.fos_commander import FOSCommander  # noqa: E402
+from fortinet.common.terminal import Data  # noqa: E402
+
+
+IP_COMMAND = "set ip 10.0.52.4/24"
+ACCESS_COMMAND = "set allowaccess ping https ssh http"
+
+
+class RecordingFeature(Feature):
+    def __init__(self, commander, block, context_action=None):
+        super().__init__(None, commander, "management")
+        self.block = block
+        self.context_action = context_action
+        self.losses = []
+        self.attempts = []
+        self.executed = []
+
+    def activate(self):
+        self.commander.submit_block(self, self.block)
+
+    def on_command_dispatched(self, attempt):
+        super().on_command_dispatched(attempt)
+        self.attempts.append(attempt)
+
+    def on_command_executed(self, attempt, state):
+        self.executed.append(attempt.spec.line)
+
+    def on_context_loss(self, attempt):
+        self.losses.append(attempt)
+        if self.context_action is not None:
+            return self.context_action
+        return super().on_context_loss(attempt)
+
+
+class RecoveryTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def make_commander(self, *, continue_on_error=False, ip_command=IP_COMMAND,
+                       context_action=None, following=False):
+        terminal = MagicMock()
+        commander = FOSCommander(terminal, MagicMock(), continue_on_error)
+        block = ConfigBlock("system interface", [EditBlock("port1", [
+            ip_command, ACCESS_COMMAND,
+        ])])
+        feature = RecordingFeature(commander, block, context_action)
+        features = [feature]
+        if following:
+            features.append(RecordingFeature(
+                commander, CommandSequence("following", ["get system status"])
+            ))
+        commander.start(features)
+        return commander, terminal, feature
+
+    def prompt(self, commander, context=None):
+        scope = f" ({context})" if context else ""
+        commander.on_state(FOSCliState.CMD_PROMPT, Data(
+            f"FGT-VM64-KVM-NSVHDM{scope} (Interim)#".encode()
+        ))
+
+    def enter_interface(self, commander):
+        self.prompt(commander, "interface")
+        self.prompt(commander, "port1")
+
+    def finish_interface(self, commander):
+        self.prompt(commander, "port1")  # IP succeeds; dispatch allowaccess.
+        self.prompt(commander, "port1")  # allowaccess succeeds; dispatch next.
+        self.prompt(commander, "interface")  # next succeeds; dispatch end.
+        self.prompt(commander)  # end succeeds.
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def writes(terminal):
+        return [call.args[0] for call in terminal.write.call_args_list]
+
+    def reconnect(self, commander):
+        commander.on_state(FOSCliState.CREDENTIAL_ACCEPTED, Data(b"Welcome!"))
+        self.prompt(commander)
+
+    def test_scope_exit_replays_openers_before_retrying_the_failed_command(self):
+        commander, terminal, feature = self.make_commander()
+        self.prompt(commander)
+        self.enter_interface(commander)
+        self.prompt(commander)  # set ip unexpectedly returns to the VDOM shell.
+        self.assertEqual(self.writes(terminal), [
+            "config system interface\r", "edit port1\r", IP_COMMAND + "\r",
+            "config system interface\r",
+        ])
+        self.assertNotIn(IP_COMMAND, feature.executed)
+        self.assertEqual(feature.losses[0].prompt_context_before, ("port1", "Interim"))
+        self.assertEqual(feature.losses[0].prompt_context_after, ("Interim",))
+        self.enter_interface(commander)
+        self.finish_interface(commander)
+        ip_attempts = [item for item in feature.attempts if item.spec.line == IP_COMMAND]
+        self.assertEqual([item.retry_count for item in ip_attempts], [0, 1])
+        self.assertTrue(feature.completed)
+        self.assertTrue(commander.ready)
+
+    def test_repeated_context_loss_obeys_retry_limit_and_bootstrap_error_policy(self):
+        for best_effort in (False, True):

+                commander, terminal, feature = self.make_commander(
+                    continue_on_error=best_effort, following=True,
+                )

+                self.enter_interface(commander)
+                self.prompt(commander)
+                self.enter_interface(commander)
+                if best_effort:

+                    self.assertIn("retry limit", commander.feature_errors[0][1])
+                    self.assertEqual(self.writes(terminal)[-1], "get system status\r")
+                else:

+                self.assertNotIn(ACCESS_COMMAND + "\r", self.writes(terminal))
+                self.assertFalse(feature.completed)

+        self.prompt(commander)
+        self.enter_interface(commander)
+        commander.on_state(FOSCliState.SESSION_LOST, Data(b"session lost"))
+        self.reconnect(commander)
+        self.enter_interface(commander)
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "retry limit"):
+            self.prompt(commander)
+        self.assertEqual(self.writes(terminal).count(IP_COMMAND + "\r"), 2)
+        self.assertEqual(feature.losses[0].retry_count, 1)
+
+    def test_repeated_session_loss_waits_for_login_before_best_effort_skip(self):
+        commander, terminal, _feature = self.make_commander(
+            continue_on_error=True, following=True,
+        )
+        self.prompt(commander)
+        self.enter_interface(commander)
+        commander.on_state(FOSCliState.SESSION_LOST, Data(b"session lost"))
+        self.reconnect(commander)
+        self.enter_interface(commander)
+        commander.on_state(FOSCliState.SESSION_LOST, Data(b"session lost again"))
+        self.assertNotIn("get system status\r", self.writes(terminal))
+        self.reconnect(commander)
+        self.assertEqual(self.writes(terminal)[-1], "get system status\r")
+        self.assertIn("retry limit", commander.feature_errors[0][1])
+
+    def test_login_without_welcome_resumes_replay_and_exhaustion_handling(self):
+        commander, terminal, _feature = self.make_commander(
+            continue_on_error=True, following=True,
+        )
+        self.prompt(commander)
+        self.enter_interface(commander)
+        commander.on_state(FOSCliState.SESSION_LOST, Data(b"session lost"))
+        self.prompt(commander)  # Successful login returns a prompt, no Welcome.
+        self.assertEqual(self.writes(terminal)[-1], "config system interface\r")
+        self.enter_interface(commander)
+        commander.on_state(FOSCliState.SESSION_LOST, Data(b"session lost again"))
+        self.assertNotIn("get system status\r", self.writes(terminal))
+        self.prompt(commander)  # Exhaustion is handled at this usable prompt.
+        self.assertEqual(self.writes(terminal)[-1], "get system status\r")
+        self.assertIn("retry limit", commander.feature_errors[0][1])
+
+    def test_each_command_position_gets_one_recovery(self):
+        commander, terminal, feature = self.make_commander()
+        self.prompt(commander)
+        self.enter_interface(commander)
+        self.prompt(commander)  # First loss: IP command.
+        self.enter_interface(commander)
+        self.prompt(commander, "port1")  # IP succeeds; dispatch allowaccess.
+        self.prompt(commander)  # Second loss: allowaccess command.
+        self.enter_interface(commander)
+        self.finish_interface(commander)
+        self.assertTrue(feature.completed)
+        self.assertEqual(self.writes(terminal).count(IP_COMMAND + "\r"), 3)
+        self.assertEqual(self.writes(terminal).count(ACCESS_COMMAND + "\r"), 2)
+
+    def test_feature_can_decline_replay_without_running_session_loss_callback(self):
+        for explicit_policy in (False, True):
+            with self.subTest(explicit_policy=explicit_policy):

+                commander, terminal, feature = self.make_commander(
+                    ip_command=IP_COMMAND if explicit_policy else spec,
+                    context_action=ContextLossAction.FAIL if explicit_policy else None,
+                )
+                feature.on_session_loss = MagicMock()
+                self.prompt(commander)
+                self.enter_interface(commander)
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "feature declined replay"):
+                    self.prompt(commander)
+                feature.on_session_loss.assert_not_called()
+                self.assertEqual(self.writes(terminal).count(IP_COMMAND + "\r"), 1)
+
+    def test_explicit_context_policy_can_allow_replay_independently_of_logout_policy(self):
+        spec = CommandSpec(
+            IP_COMMAND, session_loss=SessionLossAction.CONTINUE,
+            context_loss=ContextLossAction.RESTART_BLOCK,
+        )
+        commander, _terminal, feature = self.make_commander(ip_command=spec)
+        feature.on_session_loss = MagicMock()
+        self.prompt(commander)
+        self.enter_interface(commander)
+        self.prompt(commander)
+        self.enter_interface(commander)
+        self.finish_interface(commander)

+        feature.on_session_loss.assert_not_called()
+

+        self.prompt(commander)
+        self.enter_interface(commander)
+        self.prompt(commander, "interface")  # Only the edit context disappeared.

+"""Scope commit failures are mandatory errors, including best-effort commands."""
+
+import sys
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock

+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))
+
+from fortinet.common.cli_commands import (  # noqa: E402

+from fortinet.common.fos_commander import FOSCommander  # noqa: E402
+from fortinet.common.terminal import Data  # noqa: E402
+
+
+class RecordingFeature(Feature):
+    def __init__(self, commander, name, commands):
+        super().__init__(None, commander, name)
+        self.commands = commands
+        self.executed = []
+
+    def activate(self):
+        self.commander.submit_block(self, CommandSequence(self.name, self.commands))
+
+    def on_command_executed(self, attempt, state):
+        self.executed.append(attempt.spec.line)
+
+
+class ScopeCommitFailureTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    @staticmethod
+    def prompt(commander, context=None, output=b""):
+        scope = f" ({context})" if context else ""
+        commander.on_state(FOSCliState.CMD_PROMPT, Data(
+            output + f"fw{scope} #".encode()
+        ))
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def writes(terminal):
+        return [call.args[0] for call in terminal.write.call_args_list]
+
+    def test_closing_failure_cannot_be_disabled_or_replayed(self):
+        for close in ("next", "end"):
+            for capture in (False, True):
+                for best_effort in (False, True):
+                    with self.subTest(close=close, capture=capture, best_effort=best_effort):
+                        terminal = MagicMock()
+                        commander = FOSCommander(terminal, MagicMock(), best_effort)
+                        feature = RecordingFeature(commander, "commit", [
+                            CommandSpec(close, capture_output=capture, fail_on_error=False),
+                            "set must-not-run 1",
+                        ])
+                        feature.on_context_loss = MagicMock()
+                        following = RecordingFeature(commander, "following", ["get status"])
+                        commander.start([feature, following])
+                        self.prompt(commander, "port1")
+                        # The failure code can span multiple serial reads.
+                        for chunk in (b"Command fa", b"il. Return co", b"de -542.\r\n"):
+                            data = Data(chunk)
+                            commander.on_output(data)
+                            self.assertTrue(data.discarded)
+                        if best_effort:
+                            self.prompt(commander, "interface")
+                            self.assertEqual(self.writes(terminal), [close + "\r", "get status\r"])
+                            self.assertEqual(commander.feature_errors[0][0], "commit")
+                            self.assertIn("return code -542", commander.feature_errors[0][1])
+                        else:

FOS_CLI_STATE_PATTERNS[FOSCliState.KERNEL_PANIC.value] = (
    rb"(?mi)^Kernel panic(?: - not syncing)?:[^\r\n]*\r?\n"
    rb"CPU: [0-9]+ PID: [0-9]+ Comm: [^\r\n]+"
)

DEF_POLICY_COMPLIANT_PASSWORD = "FortinetFOS1!"
DEFAULT_USERNAME = "admin"
DEFAULT_PASSWORD = DEFAULT_USERNAME


class Credentials:
    def __init__(self, username, password) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.username = username
        self.password = password


def timed(fn):
    @wraps(fn)
    def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
        started = perf_counter()
        try:
            return fn(*args, **kwargs)
        finally:
            print(f"{fn.__qualname__}: {perf_counter() - started:.3f}s")

    return wrapper

"""Administrator bootstrap feature."""

from ..cli_commands import CommandSequence, CommandSpec, ConfigBlock, EditBlock, SessionLossAction
from ..common import FOSCliState

from .base import StaticFeature


class CredentialsFeature(StaticFeature):
    """Configure the administrator, then log out and authenticate again."""

    def __init__(self, vm, commander):
        self._activate_after_admin_commit = False
        self._desired_credentials_activated = False
        self._password_change_committed = False
        credentials = vm.desired_credentials
        admin_children = ["set accprofile super_admin"]
        if credentials.password:
            admin_children.append(CommandSpec(
                f"set password {credentials.password}",
                session_loss=SessionLossAction.CONTINUE,
                capture_output=True,
                fail_on_error=True,
            ))
        elif credentials.username == "admin":
            admin_children.append(CommandSpec(
                "unset password", session_loss=SessionLossAction.CONTINUE,
                capture_output=True,
                fail_on_error=True,
            ))
        super().__init__(vm, commander, "admin", [
            ConfigBlock("system password-policy", ["set status disable"]),
            ConfigBlock("system admin", [EditBlock(credentials.username, admin_children)]),
            CommandSequence("admin-relogin", [CommandSpec(
                "exit",
                session_loss=SessionLossAction.CONTINUE,
                capture_output=True,
                fail_on_error=True,
                # A successful logout takes the session-loss path. Returning
                # straight to a CLI prompt must not count as verification.
                expected_completion_state=FOSCliState.PROVIDE_USERNAME,
            )]),
        ], on_complete=lambda: self._activate_desired_credentials())

    def on_command_dispatched(self, attempt):
        if attempt.spec.line == "exit":
            self._activate_desired_credentials()
        super().on_command_dispatched(attempt)

    def on_session_loss(self, attempt):
        if attempt.spec.line == "exit":
            # The commander resumes this block only at the authenticated CLI
            # prompt. Clear the logout command so it cannot be replayed.
            return SessionLossAction.CONTINUE
        if self._is_password_command(attempt.spec.line):
            self._activate_desired_credentials()
            self._activate_after_admin_commit = False
            return SessionLossAction.CONTINUE
        if self._activate_after_admin_commit and attempt.spec.line == "next":
            # Some releases log out during the commit instead of returning
            # its CLI prompt. Authenticate with the committed password.
            self._activate_desired_credentials()
            self._activate_after_admin_commit = False
            self._password_change_committed = True
            return SessionLossAction.CONTINUE
        if self._password_change_committed:
            # FortiOS may log out as the admin edit closes. The password
            # command and `next` have already committed the new credentials,

import logging
import re
import time
from .common import (
    FOSCliState,
    FOS_CLI_STATE_PATTERNS,
    BOOTSTRAP_HOSTNAME_REGEX,
    PROMPT_CONTEXT_REGEX,
    TRACE_LEVEL,
)


PROCESS_SPIN_SECONDS = 10
EXPECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 1
UNKNOWN_STALL_SECONDS = 30
UNKNOWN_STALL_NEWLINE_LIMIT = 3


class KernelPanicError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when the guest kernel reports a panic on the serial console."""


class FOSCliDriver:
    """Owns serial reads and delegates command dispatch to the commander."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        terminal,
        commander,
        credentials,
        logger,
        bootstrap_password,
        activate_blank_credentials,
        activate_bootstrap_credentials,
        allow_credential_recovery=False,
    ):
        self._terminal = terminal
        self._commander = commander
        self._logger = logger
        self._state_patterns = FOS_CLI_STATE_PATTERNS.copy()
        self._last_known_state = FOSCliState.UNKNOWN
        self._current_state = FOSCliState.UNKNOWN
        self._last_logged_state = None
        self._idle_spins = 0
        self._credentials = credentials
        self._bootstrap_password = bootstrap_password
        self._activate_blank_credentials = activate_blank_credentials
        self._activate_bootstrap_credentials = activate_bootstrap_credentials
        self._allow_credential_recovery = allow_credential_recovery
        self._recovery_credentials = None
        self._recovery_attempted = False
        self._use_recovery_credentials = False
        self._blank_fallback_available = True
        self._send_blank_password = False
        self._initial_login_complete = False
        self._awaiting_login_acceptance = False
        self._credential_recovery_pending = False
        self._pending_bootstrap_activation = False
        self._unknown_started_at = None
        self._unknown_newlines = 0
        self._state_handlers = {
            FOSCliState.PROVIDE_USERNAME: self._provide_username,
            FOSCliState.PROVIDE_PASSWORD: self._provide_password,
            FOSCliState.CURRENT_PASSWORD: self._provide_current_password,
            FOSCliState.CHANGE_PASSWORD: self._provide_new_password,
            FOSCliState.CHANGE_PASSWORD_CONFIRM: self._confirm_new_password,
            FOSCliState.MORE_PROMPT: self._continue_pager,
            FOSCliState.CREDENTIAL_ACCEPTED: self._credential_accepted,
            FOSCliState.CMD_PROMPT: self._command_prompt,
            FOSCliState.CMD_PROMPT_ECHO: None,
            FOSCliState.CREDENTIAL_REJECTED: self._credential_rejected,
            FOSCliState.LIC_FAIL: self._license_failed,
            FOSCliState.TN_TIMEOUT: self._timeout,
            FOSCliState.KERNEL_PANIC: self._kernel_panic,
            FOSCliState.UNKNOWN: self._unknown,
        }

    @property
    def state_patterns(self):
        return self._state_patterns

    @property
    def ready(self):
        return self._commander.ready

    def remember_current_credentials(self):
        """Keep the last accepted credentials for a failed password transition."""
        if self._recovery_credentials is not None or self._recovery_attempted:
            return
        self._recovery_credentials = (
            self._credentials.username,
            self._credentials.password,
        )
        self._recovery_attempted = False

    @property
    def at_command_prompt(self):
        """Whether the most recent console event left FortiOS at a CLI prompt."""
        return self._current_state == FOSCliState.CMD_PROMPT or (
            self._current_state == FOSCliState.TN_TIMEOUT
            and self._last_known_state == FOSCliState.CMD_PROMPT
        )

    def process_state(self):
        spin_start = time.time()
        while not self.ready and time.time() < spin_start + PROCESS_SPIN_SECONDS:
            state, output, matched = self._next_state()
            self._current_state = state
            if output and not matched:
                self._commander.on_output(output)
                if state == FOSCliState.UNKNOWN:
                    self._note_unknown_output()
                output = type(output)(b"")
            if state.value < FOSCliState.UNKNOWN.value:
                self._idle_spins = 0
                self._last_known_state = state
                self._clear_unknown_stall()
                self._log_state(state)
            self._process_state(state, output)

    def _log_state(self, state):
        if state == FOSCliState.MULTILINE_PROMPT:
            return
        if state == FOSCliState.CMD_PROMPT and self._last_logged_state == state:
            return
        self._last_logged_state = state
        self._logger.debug(f"ST: {state.name}")

    def _process_state(self, state, output):
        """Handle a CLI state and then let the commander observe it.

        A password confirmation can be followed immediately by a command
        prompt, without ``Welcome!``.  Apply that credential transition
        before the commander dispatches the command associated with the
        prompt.
        """
        if state == FOSCliState.CMD_PROMPT:
            self._handle_state(state)
        if state == FOSCliState.CMD_PROMPT_ECHO:
            self._commander.on_prompt_echo(output)
        else:
            self._commander.on_state(state, output)
        if state != FOSCliState.CMD_PROMPT:
            self._handle_state(state)
        if state == FOSCliState.CMD_PROMPT:
            self._commander.tick()
        elif state == FOSCliState.TN_TIMEOUT and self._last_known_state == FOSCliState.CMD_PROMPT:
            self._commander.tick()
            self._commander.on_idle_prompt()

    def _next_state(self):
        index, match, output = self._terminal.expect(self._state_patterns, EXPECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
        if match:
            return FOSCliState(index), output, True
        # A timeout exposes retained bytes too. Only fresh input should reset
        # the unknown-output stall timer; an unchanged buffer is still idle.
        state = FOSCliState.UNKNOWN if output.received_new_data else FOSCliState.TN_TIMEOUT
        return state, output, False

    def _handle_state(self, state):
        handler = self._state_handlers.get(state)
        if handler:
            try:
                handler()
            except Exception:
                self._logger.exception("CLI state handler failed for %s", state.name)
                raise

    def _provide_username(self):
        username = self._credentials.username
        if self._use_recovery_credentials and self._recovery_credentials is not None:
            username = self._recovery_credentials[0]
        self._awaiting_login_acceptance = True
        self._respond(FOSCliState.PROVIDE_USERNAME, username)

    def _provide_password(self):
        if self._send_blank_password:
            # The initial blank-password fallback is consumed as soon as it is
            # sent. Later credential recovery is managed separately.
            self._send_blank_password = False
            self._blank_fallback_available = False
            self._activate_blank_credentials()
            self._respond(FOSCliState.PROVIDE_PASSWORD, b"")
            return
        if self._use_recovery_credentials and self._recovery_credentials is not None:
            self._respond(
                FOSCliState.PROVIDE_PASSWORD,
                self._recovery_credentials[1],
            )
            return
        self._respond(FOSCliState.PROVIDE_PASSWORD, self._credentials.password)

    def _provide_current_password(self):
        self._respond(FOSCliState.CURRENT_PASSWORD, self._credentials.password)

    def _provide_new_password(self):
        self._respond(FOSCliState.CHANGE_PASSWORD, self._bootstrap_password)

    def _confirm_new_password(self):
        self._respond(FOSCliState.CHANGE_PASSWORD_CONFIRM, self._bootstrap_password)
        # Do not update active credentials until FortiOS accepts the
        # confirmation. A rejected confirmation leaves the active password
        # unchanged so that subsequent prompts use the right value.
        self._pending_bootstrap_activation = True

    def _continue_pager(self):
        self._terminal.write(b" ")

    def _credential_accepted(self):
        self._accept_login()

    def _accept_login(self):
        self._initial_login_complete = True
        self._awaiting_login_acceptance = False
        recovered = (
            self._use_recovery_credentials
            and self._recovery_credentials is not None
        )
        if recovered:
            self._use_recovery_credentials = False
            self._recovery_attempted = False
            if not self._credential_recovery_pending:
                self._commander.record_feature_error(
                    "admin-credentials",
                    "desired credentials were rejected; resumed with the previous credentials "
                    "while keeping the desired credentials for later logins",
                )
            self._credential_recovery_pending = True
        elif self._recovery_credentials is not None:
            self._recovery_attempted = False
            if self._credential_recovery_pending:
                self._commander.resolve_feature_error(
                    "admin-credentials",
                    "the desired credentials authenticated successfully",
                )
                self._credential_recovery_pending = False
        self._activate_pending_bootstrap_credentials()

    def _command_prompt(self):
        """Accept password confirmation on versions that skip ``Welcome!``."""
        if self._awaiting_login_acceptance:
            self._accept_login()
        else:
            self._initial_login_complete = True
            self._activate_pending_bootstrap_credentials()

    def _activate_pending_bootstrap_credentials(self):
        if self._pending_bootstrap_activation:
            self._activate_bootstrap_credentials()
            self._pending_bootstrap_activation = False

    @staticmethod
    def _license_failed():
        # SetLicense inspects the buffered command output when FortiOS returns
        # to a prompt. Raising here would interrupt the driver at LIC_FAIL,
        # before best-effort bootstrap can safely skip the feature.
        return None

    def _timeout(self):
        self._idle_spins += 1
        self._recover_unknown_stall()

    def _unknown(self):
        if self._last_known_state == FOSCliState.REBOOTING:
            self._idle_spins += 1

    @staticmethod
    def _kernel_panic():
        raise KernelPanicError("Kernel panic detected on serial console")

    def _note_unknown_output(self):
        self._unknown_started_at = time.monotonic()

    def _recover_unknown_stall(self):
        if self._unknown_started_at is None:
            return
        if time.monotonic() - self._unknown_started_at < UNKNOWN_STALL_SECONDS:
            return
        if self._unknown_newlines >= UNKNOWN_STALL_NEWLINE_LIMIT:
            raise RuntimeError("CLI remained in unknown state")
        self._unknown_newlines += 1
        self._unknown_started_at = time.monotonic()
        self._logger.warning(
            "CLI stuck in unknown state; sending newline "
            f"({self._unknown_newlines}/{UNKNOWN_STALL_NEWLINE_LIMIT})"
        )
        self._terminal.write(b"\r")

    def _clear_unknown_stall(self):
        self._unknown_started_at = None
        self._unknown_newlines = 0

    def set_prompt_patterns(self, name_pattern):
        if isinstance(name_pattern, str):
            name_pattern = re.escape(name_pattern.encode())

"""End-to-end parsing from a serial connection through the FortiOS commander."""

import queue
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT))

from fortinet.common.cli_commands import (  # noqa: E402
    CommandSequence, CommandSpec, ConfigBlock, EditBlock, SetValue,
)
from fortinet.common.common import Credentials, FOSCliState  # noqa: E402
from fortinet.common.features.base import Feature  # noqa: E402
from fortinet.common.fos_cli_driver import FOSCliDriver  # noqa: E402
from fortinet.common.fos_commander import FOSCommander  # noqa: E402
from fortinet.common.terminal import Terminal  # noqa: E402


class SerialConnection:
    """A serial-like connection that answers each write with a byte stream."""

    def __init__(self, responses):
        self._incoming = queue.Queue()
        self._responses = responses
        self.writes = []
        self.closed = False
        self._incoming.put(b"fw login:\r\n")

    def read_very_eager(self):
        try:
            return self._incoming.get_nowait()
        except queue.Empty:
            return b""

    def write(self, data):
        data = bytes(data)
        self.writes.append(data)
        response = self._responses.get(data)
        if callable(response):
            response = response()
        if response:
            chunks = response if isinstance(response, (tuple, list)) else (response,)
            for chunk in chunks:
                if chunk:
                    self._incoming.put(bytes(chunk))

    def close(self):
        self.closed = True

    def suppress_output(self):
        from contextlib import nullcontext
        return nullcontext()


class RecordingFeature(Feature):
    def __init__(self, commander, name, commands):
        super().__init__(None, commander, name)
        self.commands = commands
        self.executed = []
        self.dispatched = []

    def activate(self):
        self.commander.submit_block(self, CommandSequence(self.name, self.commands))

    def on_command_dispatched(self, attempt):
        super().on_command_dispatched(attempt)
        self.dispatched.append(attempt)

    def on_command_executed(self, attempt, state):
        self.executed.append((attempt.spec.line, bytes(attempt.output), state))


class FullStackParsingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def make_stack(self, features, responses, *, allow_credential_recovery=False):
        logger = MagicMock()
        connection = SerialConnection(responses)
        terminal = Terminal(connection, logger, default_wait="fw #")
        commander = FOSCommander(terminal, logger)
        commander.start(features(commander))
        driver = FOSCliDriver(
            terminal=terminal,
            commander=commander,
            credentials=Credentials("admin", "secret"),
            logger=logger,
            bootstrap_password="Bootstrap1!",
            activate_blank_credentials=MagicMock(),
            activate_bootstrap_credentials=MagicMock(),
            allow_credential_recovery=allow_credential_recovery,
        )
        return connection, terminal, commander, driver

    def test_login_command_echo_multiline_output_and_continuation(self):
        result = b"".join([
            b"fw # show full-configuration system dns\r\n",
            b"config system dns\r\n",
            b"    set protocol dot\r\n",
            b"    set primary 9.9.9.9\r\n",
            b"end\r\n",
            b"fw #\r\n",
        ])
        responses = {
            b"admin\r": b"Password:",
            b"secret\r": b"Welcome!\r\nfw #\r\n",
            b"show full-configuration system dns\r": result,
            b'set comment "first line\r': b">\r\n",
            b"second line\r": b">\r\n",
            b'third line"\r': b"fw #\r\n",
        }
        features = []

        def configured(commander):
            inspect = RecordingFeature(commander, "inspect", [
                CommandSpec("show full-configuration system dns", capture_output=True),
            ])
            multiline = RecordingFeature(commander, "multiline", [
                SetValue("comment", "first line\nsecond line\nthird line"),
            ])
            features.extend([inspect, multiline])
            return features

        connection, terminal, commander, driver = self.make_stack(configured, responses)
        driver.process_state()

        self.assertTrue(commander.ready)
        self.assertTrue(commander.startup_complete)
        self.assertTrue(all(feature.completed for feature in features))
        self.assertTrue(connection.closed)
        self.assertEqual(connection.writes, [
            b"admin\r",
            b"secret\r",
            b"show full-configuration system dns\r",
            b'set comment "first line\r',
            b"second line\r",
            b'third line"\r',
        ])
        self.assertEqual(len(features[0].executed), 1)
        captured = features[0].executed[0][1]
        self.assertIn(b"set protocol dot", captured)
        self.assertIn(b"set primary 9.9.9.9", captured)
        self.assertEqual(features[0].executed[0][2], FOSCliState.CMD_PROMPT)
        self.assertEqual(
            [entry[2] for entry in features[1].executed],
            [FOSCliState.MULTILINE_PROMPT, FOSCliState.MULTILINE_PROMPT, FOSCliState.CMD_PROMPT],
        )
        self.assertTrue(all(attempt.output for attempt in features[1].dispatched))
        self.assertEqual(bytes(terminal._buffer), b"")

    def test_mixed_prompt_context_and_pager_states_reach_feature_callbacks(self):
        responses = {
            b"admin\r": b"Password:",
            b"secret\r": b"Welcome!\r\nfw (global) #\r\n",
            b"get system status\r": (
                b"fw (global) # get system status\r\n"
                b"Version: FortiGate-VM64 v7.4.2,build2571\r\n"
                b"--More--\r\n"
                b"Serial-Number: FGVMTEST\r\n"
                b"fw (global) #\r\n"
            ),
            b" \r": b"fw (global) #\r\n",
        }
        feature_ref = []

        class PagerFeature(RecordingFeature):
            def on_command_executed(self, attempt, state):
                super().on_command_executed(attempt, state)
                self.commander.feature_complete(self)

        def configured(commander):
            feature = PagerFeature(commander, "status", [
                CommandSpec("get system status", capture_output=True),
            ])
            feature_ref.append(feature)
            return [feature]

        connection, _terminal, commander, driver = self.make_stack(configured, responses)
        driver.process_state()

        feature = feature_ref[0]
        self.assertTrue(commander.ready)
        self.assertTrue(feature.completed)
        self.assertEqual(connection.writes, [
            b"admin\r", b"secret\r", b"get system status\r", b" ",
        ])
        captured = feature.executed[0][1]
        self.assertIn(b"FortiGate-VM64 v7.4.2,build2571", captured)
        self.assertIn(b"Serial-Number: FGVMTEST", captured)
        self.assertEqual(feature.executed[0][2], FOSCliState.CMD_PROMPT)
        self.assertEqual(driver._current_state, FOSCliState.CMD_PROMPT)

    def test_aborted_interface_edit_recovers_through_serial_driver(self):
        ip_responses = iter([
            b"abort\r\nfw (Interim)#\r\n",
            b"fw (port1) (Interim)#\r\n",
        ])
        responses = {
            b"admin\r": b"Password:",
            b"secret\r": b"Welcome!\r\nfw (Interim)#\r\n",
            b"config system interface\r": b"fw (interface) (Interim)#\r\n",
            b"edit port1\r": b"fw (port1) (Interim)#\r\n",
            b"set ip 10.0.52.4/24\r": lambda: next(ip_responses),
            b"set allowaccess ping https ssh http\r": b"fw (port1) (Interim)#\r\n",
            b"next\r": b"fw (interface) (Interim)#\r\n",
            b"end\r": b"fw (Interim)#\r\n",
        }
        feature_ref = []

        def configured(commander):
            feature = RecordingFeature(commander, "management", [
                ConfigBlock("system interface", [EditBlock("port1", [
                    "set ip 10.0.52.4/24", "set allowaccess ping https ssh http",
                ])]),
            ])
            feature_ref.append(feature)
            return [feature]

        connection, terminal, commander, driver = self.make_stack(configured, responses)
        try:
            driver.process_state()
            self.assertTrue(commander.ready)
            self.assertTrue(feature_ref[0].completed)
            self.assertEqual(connection.writes, [
                b"admin\r", b"secret\r",
                b"config system interface\r", b"edit port1\r", b"set ip 10.0.52.4/24\r",
                b"config system interface\r", b"edit port1\r", b"set ip 10.0.52.4/24\r",
                b"set allowaccess ping https ssh http\r", b"next\r", b"end\r",
            ])
        finally:
            terminal.close()

    def test_failed_next_ejects_before_end_through_serial_driver(self):
        responses = {
            b"admin\r": b"Password:",
            b"secret\r": b"Welcome!\r\nfw #\r\n",
            b"config system interface\r": b"fw (interface)#\r\n",
            b"edit port1\r": b"fw (port1)#\r\n",
            b"set unsupported 1\r": b"Command fail. Return code -61.\r\nfw (port1)#\r\n",
            b"next\r": (
                b"Command fa", b"il. Return code -5.\r\nfw (port1)#\r\n",
            ),
        }
        feature_ref = []

        def configured(commander):
            feature = RecordingFeature(commander, "management", [
                ConfigBlock("system interface", [EditBlock("port1", ["set unsupported 1"])]),
            ])
            feature_ref.append(feature)
            return [feature]

        connection, terminal, commander, driver = self.make_stack(configured, responses)
        try:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "'next'.*return code -5"):
                driver.process_state()
            self.assertEqual(connection.writes, [
                b"admin\r", b"secret\r", b"config system interface\r",
                b"edit port1\r", b"set unsupported 1\r", b"next\r",
            ])
            self.assertFalse(feature_ref[0].completed)
            self.assertFalse(commander.ready)
        finally:
            terminal.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

class ByteQueueTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_put_get_close_timeout_and_failure(self):
        queue = _ByteQueue(3)
        queue.put(b"abc")
        self.assertEqual(queue.get_one(), b"abc")
        queue.put(b"def")
        self.assertEqual(queue.get(), b"def")
        self.assertEqual(queue.get(0), b"")
        queue.close()
        queue.put(b"ignored")
        self.assertEqual(queue.get(), b"")
        failed = _ByteQueue(5)
        failed.fail(ValueError("read failed"))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "read failed"):
            failed.get(0)

    def test_blocked_get_wakes_when_data_arrives(self):
        queue = _ByteQueue(10)
        result = []
        reader = threading.Thread(target=lambda: result.append(queue.get(1)))
        reader.start()
        queue.put(b"ready")
        reader.join(1)
        self.assertEqual(result, [b"ready"])


class TerminalTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def terminal_with_data(self, data, limit=100):
        terminal = Terminal(MagicMock(), MagicMock())
        terminal._buffer_limit = limit
        terminal._read_queue = _ByteQueue(limit)
        terminal._read_queue.put(data)
        terminal._ensure_reader = lambda: None
        return terminal

    def test_data_wrapper_and_expect_earliest_match_preserves_tail(self):
        view = Data(b"hello")
        self.assertTrue(view)
        self.assertEqual(len(view), 5)
        self.assertIn(b"ell", view)
        self.assertEqual(view.decode(), "hello")
        self.assertTrue(view.startswith(b"he"))
        self.assertEqual(view, b"hello")
        terminal = self.terminal_with_data(b"prefix PROMPT trailing")
        index, match, output = terminal.expect([b"trailing", b"PROMPT"], timeout=0.1)
        self.assertEqual(index, 1)
        self.assertEqual(match.group(), b"PROMPT")
        self.assertEqual(bytes(output), b"prefix PROMPT")
        self.assertEqual(bytes(terminal._buffer), b" trailing")
        no_match = self.terminal_with_data(b"abc")
        result = no_match.expect([b"never"], timeout=0)
        self.assertEqual(result[0:2], (-1, None))
        self.assertEqual(bytes(result[2]), b"")

    def test_discard_retained_prefix_and_buffer_limit_error(self):
        terminal = self.terminal_with_data(b"output prompt", limit=20)
        _, _, _ = terminal.expect([b"prompt"], timeout=0.1)
        data = Data(b"output", terminal._discard_prefix)
        terminal._buffer = bytearray(b"output trailing")
        data.discard(b"output")
        self.assertTrue(data.discarded)
        self.assertEqual(bytes(terminal._buffer), b" trailing")
        data.discard(b"wrong")
        terminal._buffer = bytearray(b"123456")
        terminal._buffer_limit = 5
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "exceeded 5"):
            terminal._enforce_buffer_limit()
        terminal._logger.error.assert_called_once()

    def test_timeout_preserves_partial_token_for_a_later_read(self):
        terminal = self.terminal_with_data(b"Login incor")
        pattern = rb"(?m)^Login incorrect\r?$"
        index, match, output = terminal.expect([pattern], timeout=0.001)
        self.assertEqual((index, match), (-1, None))
        self.assertEqual(bytes(output), b"Login incor")
        # Inspection without discard keeps the partial token, including when
        # another wait expires without receiving any more bytes.
        _, _, output = terminal.expect([pattern], timeout=0)
        self.assertEqual(bytes(output), b"Login incor")
        terminal._read_queue.put(b"rect\n")
        index, match, output = terminal.expect([pattern], timeout=0.1)
        self.assertEqual(index, 0)
        self.assertEqual(match.group(), b"Login incorrect")
        self.assertEqual(bytes(output), b"Login incorrect")
        self.assertEqual(bytes(terminal._buffer), b"\n")

    def test_timeout_inspection_sees_a_token_completed_by_new_input(self):
        terminal = self.terminal_with_data(b"Verifying pass")
        _, _, output = terminal.expect([b"fw #"], timeout=0.001)
        self.assertIsNone(re.search(rb"Verifying password", bytes(output)))

        terminal._read_queue.put(b"word...\n")
        _, match, output = terminal.expect([b"fw #"], timeout=0.001)
        self.assertIsNone(match)
        self.assertIsNotNone(re.search(rb"Verifying password", bytes(output)))
        self.assertEqual(bytes(terminal._buffer), b"Verifying password...\n")
        output.discard()
        self.assertEqual(bytes(terminal._buffer), b"")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse
import logging
import os
import re
import select
import signal
import sys
import time
from contextlib import contextmanager

import vrnetlab
from .common import Credentials, DEFAULT_PASSWORD, DEFAULT_USERNAME, DEF_POLICY_COMPLIANT_PASSWORD, TRACE_LEVEL
from .features import (
    CredentialsFeature,
    ConfigureMgmtDns,
    ConfigSaveFeature,
    FormatDisks,
    FeatureFileWatcher,
    DefaultConfig,
    ConfigureFortiGuardHooks,
    ReapplyFortiGuardHooks,
    SetLicense,
    WaitForLicenseValidation,
    WaitForFortiTokens,
    ConfigureMgmtNetwork,
    ReconfigureMgmtNetwork,
    MoveMgmtToVrf1,
    ImageInfo,
    InstallPkiCertificates,
    ApplyStartupConfig,
    ValidateProduct,
)
from .env import get_env
from .fos_cli_driver import FOSCliDriver, KernelPanicError
from .fos_commander import FOSCommander
from .host_forwarded_bridge import HostForwardedBridge
from .net_mgmt_strategy import NetMgmtStrategy
from .passthrough_redirect import PassthroughRedirect
from .terminal import Terminal
from .tftp import TFTPServer


def handle_SIGCHLD(_unused_signal, _unused_frame):
    os.waitpid(-1, os.WNOHANG)


def handle_SIGTERM(_unused_signal, _unused_frame):
    sys.exit(0)


signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, handle_SIGTERM)
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, handle_SIGTERM)
signal.signal(signal.SIGCHLD, handle_SIGCHLD)

TRACE_LEVEL_NUM = TRACE_LEVEL
# Appended to once per main-loop iteration; fos_healthcheck.py watches this
# file to tell a slow bootstrap from a wedged launcher. Keep in sync with the
# HEARTBEAT_FILE default in fos_healthcheck.py.
HEARTBEAT_FILE = get_env("FOS_HEARTBEAT_FILE", "/healthbeat")
logging.addLevelName(TRACE_LEVEL_NUM, "\x1b[1;35m\tTRACE\x1b[0m")
LOG_LEVEL_NAMES = {
    "TRACE": TRACE_LEVEL_NUM,
    "DEBUG": logging.DEBUG,
    "INFO": logging.INFO,
    "WARN": logging.WARN,
    "WARNING": logging.WARNING,
    "ERROR": logging.ERROR,
    "CRITICAL": logging.CRITICAL,
    "FATAL": logging.FATAL,
}


def trace(self, message, *args, **kws):
    # Yes, logger takes its '*args' as 'args'.
    if self.isEnabledFor(TRACE_LEVEL_NUM):
        self.log(TRACE_LEVEL_NUM, message, *args, **kws)


logging.Logger.trace = trace
MGMT_PASSTHROUGH_DEFAULT = True
TFTP_PORT = 69
TFTP_TID_RANGE = (52400, 52500)
TFTP_DIRECTORY = "/tftpboot"


def parse_log_level(value):
    if value is None or str(value).strip() == "":
        return logging.DEBUG
    value = str(value).strip()
    try:
        return int(value)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    normalized = value.upper()
    if normalized in LOG_LEVEL_NAMES:
        return LOG_LEVEL_NAMES[normalized]
    raise ValueError(
        "Invalid FOS_LOG_LEVEL. Use TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, "
        "another Python logging level name, or a numeric level."
    )


def exit_on_bootstrap_error(value=None):
    """Return whether a bootstrap exception should terminate the VM.

    Bootstrap failures are fatal by default.  The opt-out is intentionally
    narrow: only the explicit value ``false`` disables termination, so a
    misspelled or otherwise invalid value keeps the fail-fast behavior.
    """
    if value is None:
        value = get_env("FOS_EXIT_ON_BOOTSTRAP_ERROR", "true")
    return str(value).strip().lower() != "false"


def container_dns_servers(path="/etc/resolv.conf"):
    """Return nameserver addresses configured for this container, in order."""
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as resolver_config:
            servers = []
            for line in resolver_config:
                fields = line.split()
                if len(fields) >= 2 and fields[0] == "nameserver":
                    servers.append(fields[1])
            return servers
    except OSError:
        return []


def apply_debug_feature_cutoff(features, stop_feature, logger):
    """Limit bootstrap features to those up to and including ``stop_feature``."""
    if stop_feature is None or str(stop_feature).strip() == "":
        return features

    stop_feature = str(stop_feature).strip()
    for index, feature in enumerate(features):
        if feature.name == stop_feature:
            selected = features[:index + 1]
            skipped = features[index + 1:]
            logger.warning(
                "FOS_DEBUG_FEATURE=%s; stopping after feature %s. Skipping: %s",
                stop_feature,
                stop_feature,
                ", ".join(feature.name for feature in skipped) or "(none)",
            )
            return selected

    available = ", ".join(feature.name for feature in features)
    raise ValueError(f"Unknown FOS_DEBUG_FEATURE '{stop_feature}'. Available features: {available}")


class FortiOSConsole(vrnetlab._Console):
    def __init__(self, driver):
        super().__init__(driver)
        self._output_enabled = True

    def _read(self):
        data = self._driver.channel.read()
        if data and self._output_enabled:
            sys.stdout.buffer.write(data)
            sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        return data

    def read_very_eager(self):
        transport_socket = getattr(self._driver.transport, "socket", None)
        socket = getattr(transport_socket, "sock", None)
        if socket is not None:
            readable, _, _ = select.select([socket], [], [], 0)
            if not readable:
                return b""
        return self._read()

    def read_blocking(self):
        return self._read()

    @contextmanager
    def suppress_output(self):
        output_enabled = self._output_enabled
        self._output_enabled = False
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            self._output_enabled = output_enabled


class FortiOS_vm(vrnetlab.VM):
    def __init__(self, hostname: str, username, password, conn_mode, mgmt_net: NetMgmtStrategy,
                 expected_product="FortiGate"):
        disk_image = None
        for e in os.listdir("."):
            if re.search(".qcow2$", e):
                disk_image = "./" + e
        if disk_image is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Could not find image to boot")
        super(FortiOS_vm, self).__init__(
            username,
            password,
            disk_image=disk_image,
            ram=2048,
            driveif="virtio",
            # fortios fails to respond to network requests if the pci bus is setup :D
            provision_pci_bus=False,
            mgmt_passthrough=mgmt_net.mgmt_passthrough
        )
        self.tn = FortiOSConsole(self.scrapli_tn)

        self.logger.info(f"Launching. commandline: {' '.join(sys.argv)}")
        self.logger.warning("deploy --reconfigure, deploy --restore, redeploy, restart, restore, save, stop-then-start,"
                            " not supported at this moment.")
        self.conn_mode = conn_mode
        self.hostname = hostname
        self.num_nics = 12
        self.nic_type = "virtio-net-pci"
        self.highest_port = 0
        self.spins = 0
        self.stopped = False
        self._bootstrap_error = None
        self._exit_on_bootstrap_error = exit_on_bootstrap_error()
        self.waiting_for = False
        self._mgmt_net = mgmt_net
        self.expected_product = expected_product
        self._mgmt_net.configure_vm_mgmt(self)
        container_dns = container_dns_servers()
        primary_dns = get_env(
            "FOS_MGMT_DNS_PRIMARY",
            aliases=("FTNT_DNS_PRIMARY",),
        )
        secondary_dns = get_env(
            "FOS_MGMT_DNS_SECONDARY",
            aliases=("FTNT_DNS_SECONDARY",),
            legacy_aliases=("FTNT_MGMG_DNS_SECONDARY", "FOS_MGMG_DNS_SECONDARY"),
        )
        if primary_dns is None:
            primary_dns = container_dns[0] if container_dns else "1.1.1.1"
        if secondary_dns is None:
            secondary_dns = container_dns[1] if len(container_dns) > 1 else "8.8.8.8"
        self.mgmt_dns_primary = primary_dns
        self.mgmt_dns_secondary = secondary_dns
        self.mgmt_dns_protocol = get_env("FTNT_DNS_PROTOCOL", "cleartext")
        self.terminal = Terminal(self.tn, self.logger, default_wait=self.wait_pattern)
        desired_password = DEFAULT_PASSWORD if password is None else password
        self._bootstrap_username = DEFAULT_USERNAME
        self._bootstrap_password = DEF_POLICY_COMPLIANT_PASSWORD
        self.credentials = Credentials(self._bootstrap_username, self._bootstrap_password)
        self.desired_credentials = Credentials(username or DEFAULT_USERNAME, desired_password)
        self.commander = FOSCommander(
            terminal=self.terminal,
            logger=self.logger,
            continue_on_error=not self._exit_on_bootstrap_error,
        )
        self.fos_version = None
        self.fos_product = None
        self.driver = FOSCliDriver(
            self.terminal,
            self.commander,
            self.credentials,
            self.logger,
            self._bootstrap_password,
            self.activate_blank_credentials,
            self.activate_bootstrap_credentials,
            # Always retry the last accepted credentials after a desired
            # password transition is rejected. The bootstrap error policy
            # controls feature failures, not whether the console can recover.
            allow_credential_recovery=True,
        )
        configure_dns = ConfigureMgmtDns(self, self.commander)
        license_validation = WaitForLicenseValidation(self, self.commander)
        self._features = [
            ImageInfo(self, self.commander),
            ValidateProduct(self, self.commander, expected_product),
            FormatDisks(self, self.commander),
            CredentialsFeature(self, self.commander),
            ConfigureMgmtNetwork(self, self.commander),
            configure_dns,
            ConfigureFortiGuardHooks(self, self.commander),
            SetLicense(self, self.commander),
            ReapplyFortiGuardHooks(self, self.commander),
            DefaultConfig(self, self.commander),
            ReconfigureMgmtNetwork(self, self.commander),
            license_validation,
            WaitForFortiTokens(self, self.commander, license_validation),
            InstallPkiCertificates(self, self.commander),
            MoveMgmtToVrf1(self, self.commander),
            ConfigSaveFeature(self, self.commander),
            ApplyStartupConfig(self, self.commander),
        ]
        self._features = apply_debug_feature_cutoff(
            self._features,
            get_env("FOS_DEBUG_FEATURE"),
            self.logger,
        )
        self._file_watcher = FeatureFileWatcher(self._features, self.logger)
        self.commander.start(self._features)
        vrnetlab.run_command(
            ["qemu-img", "create", "-f", "qcow2", "empty.qcow2", "30G"]
        )

        # Comma-separated list of disk sizes to install in the machine. as accepted by qemu-img create.
        disk_specs = get_env("FOS_DISK_SPECS", "").split(",")
        if disk_specs[0] == '':
            self.logger.warning(
                "No additional disks configured. Use FOS_DISK_SPECS to specify a comma-separated list of disk sizes")
            return
        index = 0
        for spec in disk_specs:
            index += 1
            # set up the extra empty disk image
            # for fortigate logs
            vrnetlab.run_command(
                ["qemu-img", "create", "-f", "qcow2", f"empty{index}.qcow2", spec]
            )

            self.qemu_args.extend(
                [
                    "-drive",
                    f"if=virtio,format=qcow2,file=empty{index}.qcow2,index={index}",
                ]
            )

            index += 1

    def bootstrap_spin(self):
        """This function should be called periodically to do work.

        returns False when it has failed and given up, otherwise True
        """
        if self._bootstrap_error is not None:
            return False
        try:
            self.driver.process_state()
        except KernelPanicError:
            self.stop()
            raise
        except Exception as error:
            if self._exit_on_bootstrap_error or self.commander.startup_complete:
                self.stop()
                raise
            failed_work = self.commander.continue_after_error(
                error,
                at_command_prompt=self.driver.at_command_prompt,
            )
            if failed_work is not None:
                self.logger.exception(
                    "Bootstrap work %s failed; continuing with remaining features "
                    "because FOS_EXIT_ON_BOOTSTRAP_ERROR=false",
                    failed_work,
                )
                return True
            self._bootstrap_error = error
            self.logger.exception(
                "Bootstrap cannot continue safely; keeping the VM running for manual "
                "repair because FOS_EXIT_ON_BOOTSTRAP_ERROR=false"
            )
            try:
                self.terminal.close()
                self.logger.info(
                    "Released the launcher's serial Telnet connection after bootstrap stopped"
                )
            except Exception:
                self.logger.exception(
                    "Failed to release the serial Telnet connection after bootstrap stopped"
                )
            return False
        if self.driver.ready and not self.commander.feature_errors:
            self.running = True
        return True

    def work(self):
        self._write_heartbeat()
        super().work()
        if self.running:
            self._file_watcher.poll()
            if not self.driver.ready:
                self.bootstrap_spin()

    def _write_heartbeat(self):
        """Append one byte to the healthcheck heartbeat file.

        ``fos_healthcheck.py`` blocks in "starting" as long as this file
        keeps growing, so a slow but progressing bootstrap never trips the
        Docker unhealthy threshold. A wedged launcher stops beating and the
        probe reports failure. Best-effort: a heartbeat write must never
        take down the main loop.
        """
        try:
            with open(HEARTBEAT_FILE, "a") as heartbeat_handle:
                heartbeat_handle.write("\n")
        except OSError:
            self.logger.debug("Failed to write healthcheck heartbeat", exc_info=True)

    def connect_serial_console(self):
        try:
            self.terminal.close()
        except Exception:
            pass

        for attempt in range(1, vrnetlab.MAX_RETRIES + 1):
            try:
                self.tn.open()
                break
            except Exception:
                if attempt == vrnetlab.MAX_RETRIES:
                    self.logger.exception("Failed to connect to VM serial port.")
                    self.stop()
                    raise
                self.logger.error(
                    f"Unable to connect to VM serial port {5000 + self.num}, "
                    f"retrying in a second (attempt {attempt})"
                )
                time.sleep(1)

        self.stopped = False
        self.terminal.write(b"\r")

    def activate_desired_credentials(self):
        self.driver.remember_current_credentials()
        self.credentials.username = self.desired_credentials.username
        self.credentials.password = self.desired_credentials.password

    def activate_bootstrap_credentials(self):
        self.credentials.username = self._bootstrap_username
        self.credentials.password = self._bootstrap_password

    def activate_blank_credentials(self):
        self.credentials.password = ""

    def gen_mgmt(self):
        return self._mgmt_net.gen_mgmt(self)

    @staticmethod
    def mgmt_gateway_destination(gateway, mgmt_address):
        _address, separator, prefix = str(mgmt_address).partition("/")
        if separator and prefix:
            return f"{gateway}/{prefix}"
        return f"{gateway}/{'128' if ':' in str(gateway) else '32'}"

    def stop(self):
        self.stopped = True
        super().stop()


class FortiOS(vrnetlab.VR):
    def __init__(self, hostname, username, password, conn_mode, mgmt_net: NetMgmtStrategy,
                 expected_product="FortiGate"):
        super(FortiOS, self).__init__(username, password, mgmt_passthrough=mgmt_net.mgmt_passthrough)
        self.logger.debug("Hostname")
        self.logger.debug(hostname)
        self.vms = [FortiOS_vm(hostname, username, password, conn_mode, mgmt_net=mgmt_net,
                               expected_product=expected_product)]


def main(expected_product="FortiGate"):

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--trace", action="store_true", help="enable trace level logging"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--hostname", default="vr-fortinet", help="Fortinet hostname")
    parser.add_argument("--username", default=None, help="Username")
    parser.add_argument("--password", default=None, help="Password", nargs="?")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--connection-mode",
        default="tc",
        help="Connection mode to use in the datapath",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    LOG_FORMAT = "%(asctime)s: %(module)-10s %(levelname)-8s %(message)s"
    logging.basicConfig(format=LOG_FORMAT)
    logger = logging.getLogger()

    logger.setLevel(parse_log_level(get_env("FOS_LOG_LEVEL")))

    mgmt_passthrough = (
        os.environ.get("CLAB_MGMT_PASSTHROUGH", "").lower() == "true"
        if os.environ.get("CLAB_MGMT_PASSTHROUGH")
        else MGMT_PASSTHROUGH_DEFAULT
    )

    tftp_server = None

"""Admin credential commits followed by logout and console authentication."""

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))

from fortinet.common.common import Credentials
from fortinet.common.features.credentials import CredentialsFeature
from fortinet.common.fos_cli_driver import FOSCliDriver
from fortinet.common.fos_commander import FOSCommander
from fortinet.common.terminal import Terminal
from fortinet.tests.test_common_stack_parsing import RecordingFeature, SerialConnection


LOGIN = b"fw login:\r\n"
READY = b"Welcome!\r\nfw #\r\n"
ADMIN_PROMPT = b"fw (admin) #\r\n"


class AdminCredentialsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def make_stack(self, *, password="newpass", username="admin",
                   auto_logout=None, authenticate=True, reject=False,
                   exit_works=True):
        logger = MagicMock()
        policy_prompt = b"fw (password-policy) #\r\n"
        old_password_responses = [READY]
        if password:
            old_password_responses.append(ADMIN_PROMPT)
        old_password_responses.append(b"Login incorrect\r\n" + LOGIN)
        end_count = 0

        def end_response():
            nonlocal end_count
            end_count += 1
            return LOGIN if auto_logout == "end" and end_count == 2 else b"fw #\r\n"

        login_reply = None if not authenticate else (
            b"Login incorrect\r\n" + LOGIN if reject else READY
        )
        responses = {
            b"admin\r": b"Password:",
            b"oldpass\r": lambda: old_password_responses.pop(0),
            b"config system password-policy\r": policy_prompt,
            b"set status disable\r": policy_prompt,
            b"config system admin\r": ADMIN_PROMPT,
            f"edit {username}\r".encode(): ADMIN_PROMPT,
            b"set accprofile super_admin\r": ADMIN_PROMPT,
            b"next\r": LOGIN if auto_logout == "next" else ADMIN_PROMPT,
            b"end\r": end_response,
            b"exit\r": LOGIN if exit_works else b"fw #\r\n",
            b"probe\r": b"fw #\r\n",
            (password + "\r").encode(): login_reply,
        }
        if username != "admin":
            responses[(username + "\r").encode()] = b"Password:"
        if password:
            responses[f"set password {password}\r".encode()] = (
                b"Please enter current administrator password: "
            )
        else:
            responses[b"unset password\r"] = ADMIN_PROMPT

        connection = SerialConnection(responses)
        terminal = Terminal(connection, logger)
        commander = FOSCommander(terminal, logger)
        credentials = Credentials("admin", "oldpass")
        driver = FOSCliDriver(
            terminal, commander, credentials, logger, "bootstrap",
            MagicMock(), MagicMock(), allow_credential_recovery=True,
        )

        def activate_desired():
            driver.remember_current_credentials()
            credentials.username = username
            credentials.password = password

        vm = SimpleNamespace(
            desired_credentials=Credentials(username, password),
            activate_desired_credentials=activate_desired,
        )
        admin = CredentialsFeature(vm, commander)
        following = RecordingFeature(commander, "following", ["probe"])
        commander.start([admin, following])
        self.addCleanup(lambda: terminal.close() if not connection.closed else None)
        return connection, commander, driver, admin, following

    def run_driver(self, driver):
        with patch("fortinet.common.fos_cli_driver.EXPECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", 0.01), \
                patch("fortinet.common.fos_cli_driver.PROCESS_SPIN_SECONDS", 0.15):
            driver.process_state()

    def test_logout_and_relogin_after_committing_credentials(self):
        for username, password in (("admin", "newpass"), ("admin", ""),
                                   ("operator", "newpass")):
            with self.subTest(username=username, password_set=bool(password)):
                conn, cmd, driver, admin, following = self.make_stack(
                    username=username, password=password,
                )
                self.run_driver(driver)
                self.assertTrue(cmd.ready)
                self.assertTrue(admin.completed)
                self.assertTrue(following.completed)
                logout = conn.writes.index(b"exit\r")
                self.assertEqual(conn.writes[logout - 1], b"end\r")
                self.assertEqual(conn.writes[logout + 1:], [
                    (username + "\r").encode(),
                    (password + "\r").encode(),
                    b"probe\r",
                ])
                self.assertEqual(conn.writes.count(b"exit\r"), 1)

    def test_later_features_wait_for_authentication(self):
        conn, cmd, driver, admin, following = self.make_stack(authenticate=False)
        self.run_driver(driver)
        self.assertIn(b"exit\r", conn.writes)
        self.assertIn(b"newpass\r", conn.writes)
        self.assertNotIn(b"probe\r", conn.writes)
        self.assertFalse(admin.completed)
        self.assertFalse(following.completed)
        self.assertFalse(cmd.ready)

    def test_fortios_logout_at_commit_does_not_replay_password_change(self):
        for commit_command in ("next", "end"):
            with self.subTest(commit_command=commit_command):
                conn, cmd, driver, admin, _ = self.make_stack(auto_logout=commit_command)
                self.run_driver(driver)
                self.assertTrue(cmd.ready)
                self.assertTrue(admin.completed)
                self.assertEqual(conn.writes.count(b"set password newpass\r"), 1)
                self.assertEqual(conn.writes.count(b"exit\r"), 1)
                self.assertEqual(conn.writes.count(b"newpass\r"), 2)

    def test_logout_must_return_to_login(self):
        conn, _, driver, admin, _ = self.make_stack(exit_works=False)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "expected PROVIDE_USERNAME"):
            self.run_driver(driver)
        self.assertFalse(admin.completed)
        self.assertNotIn(b"probe\r", conn.writes)

    def test_rejected_credentials_do_not_start_later_features(self):
        conn, _, driver, admin, _ = self.make_stack(reject=True)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "Credential rejected"):
            self.run_driver(driver)
        self.assertFalse(admin.completed)
        self.assertNotIn(b"probe\r", conn.writes)
        self.assertEqual(conn.writes.count(b"set password newpass\r"), 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
